description: Mastra agent run with one tool call, exported by Mastra's OtelExporter with its default span tree.
notes: The agent is weather-agent with one tool, get_weather, on openai.chat('gpt-4o-mini') at the mock. The exporter gets the runner's traces endpoint itself, with logs off, and the scenario calls shutdown to flush. The kept tree is invoke_agent [agent] > agent_step [model step] > chat [llm] and execute_tool get_weather, plus generic and model_generation spans; the agent span and its steps carry the run's input and output in mastra.* keys. processor_run and model_chunk spans are dropped: their names and count are exporter internals. mastra.metadata.runId and mastra.metadata.headers (the response date) are random or time-based, and mastra.model_generation.input repeats the prompt with createdAt clock stamps; all three are listed as volatile. mastra.completion_start_time is an instant, shifted with the spans. No telemetry leaves the process: the mock is the only host.
